purpose: Expand the M100 stock/option strategy allocation grid while preserving fold-level checkpoints so long searches can resume before market open.

checkpointing.resume_rule: If the checkpoint signature matches the current row count and parameter grid, completed folds are reused.

live_replay_evidence.command: python main.py replay-score-strategy-walk-forward-tune --start 2025-01-01 --scorer-name openai --model-name gpt-5.4-mini --scorer-version openai-replay-score-v14-nuanced-v1 --price-source yahoo_chart_daily_adjclose --limit 1000 --min-train-rows 240 --test-window-rows 80 --step-rows 80 --min-confidence-grid 0.30,0.325,0.35,0.375,0.40 --min-stock-expected-return-grid 0.0025,0.005,0.0075,0.01 --min-option-score-grid 0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40,0.45 --min-option-return-on-risk-grid 0.0,0.05,0.10,0.15,0.25 --option-preference-edge-grid 0.0,0.025,0.05,0.075,0.10 --checkpoint-path work/m102_stock_option_wide_grid_checkpoint.json

interpretation.versus_narrow_m100: The wide grid selected fewer trades, slightly improved positive rate and average paper PnL, but reduced total paper PnL versus the stored M100 artifact.
interpretation.operating_use: Treat the wide-grid result as a refined candidate, not automatic replacement. Compare against M100 and liquidity-gated M101 before execution work.
